description:
JUNIOR DEVELOPER

We are seeking for an enthusiastic and talented colleague to join our team as Junior Developer. This is an exciting opportunity for those looking to kickstart their career in the field of software development.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the design, development, and testing of software applications
  • Collaborate with senior developers to learn new technologies and best practices
  • Debug code and troubleshoot software issues
  • Participate in team meetings and contribute ideas to project discussions

Requirements:

Ideal candidate must have minimum experience with:

• HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Ajax
• Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator)
• Ability to convert design PSD in cod HTML functional, for web pages and email newsletters
• Knowledge to develop responsive web pages

• Mandatory working from the office (no option for remote work)



Advantage and salary bonus for experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, SQL, preprocesor CSS (SASS) , Git, PHP.

We offer a very dynamic and pleasant working environment, professional development, net income based on exprience and work output starting entry level, periodically salary upgrades.

Good to know that:

  • We are a very cool team with inteligent and friendly colleagues, a strong team (aprox 25) 
  • We have great infrastructure and latest technology tools;
  • Working hours from 10 to 19 with lunch break from 13 to 14 ocl;
  • We develop inovative projects and we have more than 15 years experience in engagement and interactive tactics; 
  • Our offices are in a beautiful villa in sector 1. 

 

If you are passionate about software development and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply for the Junior Developer position. Join us in shaping the future of technology!
